content.title: AI needs software to see investments pay off: ZoomInfo CEO
content.description:
Software stocks, like ZoomInfo (GTM), DocuSign (DOCU), and HubSpot (HUBS), are under pressure as the market reevaluates the sector's place in tech amid the artificial intelligence (AI) era, while OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) strikes deals with Nvidia (NVDA) and AMD (AMD).

ZoomInfo CEO Henry Schuck joins Opening Bid with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss software companies' role in enterprises adopting AI.
